import re

output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/58147_0_a6bc2d7b/1_58147_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Here"]

def eval_simple_cell_formula(cell_ref):
    """Evaluate only the simple formulas used in this workbook, enough for I2:I6."""
    val = ws[cell_ref].value
    if val is None:
        return ""
    if not isinstance(val, str) or not val.startswith("="):
        return str(val)
    
    # Handle =1&" - "&F2 or =2&" - "&F22
    m = re.fullmatch(r'=(\d+)&" - "&([A-Z]+[0-9]+)', val)
    if m:
        return f"{m.group(1)} - {eval_simple_cell_formula(m.group(2))}"
    
    # Handle direct reference like =C4, =F22
    m = re.fullmatch(r'=([A-Z]+[0-9]+)', val)
    if m:
        return eval_simple_cell_formula(m.group(1))
    
    # Handle =IF(Sheet1!F2="","",Sheet1!F2)
    m = re.fullmatch(r'=IF\(Sheet1!([A-Z]+[0-9]+)="","",Sheet1!\1\)', val)
    if m:
        ref = m.group(1)
        return "" if wb["Sheet1"][ref].value in (None, "") else str(wb["Sheet1"][ref].value)
    
    return str(val)

def extract_outcome(text):
    s = "" if text is None else str(text).strip()
    # remove leading "number - " if present
    s = re.sub(r'^\d+\s*-\s*', '', s).strip()
    # remove trailing " - ID" portion
    if " - " in s:
        s = s.rsplit(" - ", 1)[0].strip()
    return s

for row in range(2, 7):
    i_text = eval_simple_cell_formula(f"I{row}")
    ws[f"J{row}"] = extract_outcome(i_text)

wb.save(output_path)

# Verify the written literals
wb_check = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
ws_check = wb_check["Here"]
for row in range(2, 7):
    print(f"J{row} = {ws_check[f'J{row}'].value!r}")
